planner.node_purpose: Turn the frozen DELL question tree and answer-free branch methods into a bounded set of evidence and financial-fact requests without answering the case.
planner.input_scale: One research question, one as-of date, and at most 16 compact branch method records; no evidence corpus or prior model conversation.
planner.schema_burden: Up to 16 tasks, each with no more than 8 evidence requests and 24 typed financial-fact requests.
planner.materiality_quality_risk: An omitted required branch or vague request can starve every downstream specialist; the graph separately rejects unknown or missing required branches.
planner.comparable_run_evidence: No paid run exists for this new vertical; the full nine-branch deterministic fixture serializes to 81,082 characters, so a 120,000-character fail-before-transport ceiling leaves bounded headroom while the first real call remains a qualification attempt.

specialist.node_purpose: One autonomous Q1 issuer-truth Specialist should read current issuer narrative and frozen source documents, query S2, then produce an evidence-linked Chinese research workpaper; this is not the complete multi-agent product.
specialist.input_scale: R10 reached 370397 serialized input characters before its second corrective exchange; the 360000-character host ceiling stopped it before transport. Keep original source content, SDK history, prior reasoning and all feedback. A 500000-character host bound accommodates measured source history plus roughly two further complete correction responses; this is not a provider context-window limit. DeepSeek official model documentation lists a 1M-token context window. Other role budgets, 32000 combined output tokens and twelve-turn/eleven-tool ceilings remain unchanged.
required_outputs: source-bound Chinese workpaper with claim rationales
specialist.schema_burden: Five existing native tools and the original workpaper schema. Pydantic field descriptions now explain numeric_authority across claim kinds. Source quotation/context and calculated origin remain explicit; a derived S2 result is not a GAAP classification or direct issuer statement. Complete field/semantic feedback may require several full workpaper resubmissions; the input bound must allow that realistic burden.
specialist.materiality_quality_risk: Issuer evidence and finance periods differ. Prioritize S2 for accounting values, disclose source-only orders/backlog/guidance, verify quotation context. Source parsing failures are attributed separately from agent errors, never financial quality PASS.
specialist.comparable_run_evidence: R8 established combined-output capacity needs; R9 generated a complete 22218-token response. R10 produced a complete workpaper, received real field validation feedback, and corrected those fields on the next model turn, but the following correction would require 370397 input characters and was stopped by the 360000 local bound. Existing S2 already computes free_cash_flow/gross_margin/operating_margin with formula_trace; restore their omitted capability disclosure, do not create a calculator or inject a case answer. Same read-only scope and model, no retry/resume or silent evidence trimming.

counter.node_purpose: Stress-test the complete first-pass workpaper set and optionally request one material, targeted branch rework.
counter.input_scale: At most 16 compact branch workpapers from one case and no prior provider conversation or hidden reasoning history.
required_outputs: zero or one targeted reroute request
counter.schema_burden: One counter decision with up to 12 challenges and a single optional reroute containing bounded Evidence and Finance requests.
counter.materiality_quality_risk: An indiscriminate reroute creates cost and latency without improving the case; graph topology permits only one branch and one rework round.
counter.comparable_run_evidence: Deterministic fixtures prove the one-reroute topology and host challenge binding; no paid counter-node qualification exists yet.

lead.node_purpose: Synthesize all effective DELL branch workpapers and the explicit countercase into a source-linked executive conclusion without hiding uncertainty.
lead.input_scale: At most 16 effective branch workpapers plus one counter decision from a single case; no raw corpus and no cross-request provider history.
required_outputs: one conclusion for every active branch
preserved Evidence and Fact ID references
lead.schema_burden: A full executive synthesis with an 8000-character summary, a required conclusion per branch, and bounded source-reference sets.
lead.materiality_quality_risk: This node is the user-visible analytical synthesis; generic prose, missing branches, invented references, or concealed counterevidence would invalidate the demonstration.
lead.comparable_run_evidence: The graph verifier proves complete branch coverage and reference containment on fake outputs; real product quality remains unproved until a paid qualification artifact and human review.
